text:
Petroleum is separated by fractional distillation.
Which statement about the fractions produced is correct?
A
Bottled gas for heating and cooking is obtained from the naphtha fraction.
B
Diesel oil is used as a fuel for jet aircraft.
C
Substances used to make polishes are obtained from the lubricating fraction.
D
The kerosene fraction contains many useful waxes.

options.label: A
options.text: Bottled gas for heating and cooking is obtained from the naphtha fraction.

options.label: B
options.text: Diesel oil is used as a fuel for jet aircraft.

options.label: C
options.text: Substances used to make polishes are obtained from the lubricating fraction.

options.label: D
options.text: The kerosene fraction contains many useful waxes.
